sanskrit: sarvadānandahṛdaya sarvāgamaprakāśakavidyāstāḥ sakalā deva phalāni tvatprasādataḥatīvedaṃ rahaḥsthānaṃ tenāhaṃ śravaṇodyatāyonirūpā mahāvidyā kāmākhyā varadāyinīsarveṣāṃ jananī sāpi sarveṣāṃ tāriṇī matātasyāstantraṃ pravakṣyāmi sāvadhānā'vadhārayayatra kutrāpi kenāpi kāmākhyā phaladāyinīvinā kāmātmikāṃ kāpi na dātrī siddhisampadāmkāmākhyā kāmasampattiḥ kāmākhyā mokṣa eva casālokyaṃ saharūpaṃ ca kāmākhyā paramā gatiḥdevatvaṃ sarvadevānāṃ niścitaṃ kāmarūpiṇīkāmākhyāyā mahādevyāḥ svarūpaṃ sarvameva hikāmākhyāṃ na vinā kiñcid vidyate bhuvanatrayesārāt sāratamā devi sarveṣāṃ ṣoḍaśī matācandrakāntiryathā devi jāyate līyate punaḥsatyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ vinā tāṃ naiva jāyate|| iti śrīkāmākhyātantre devīśvarasaṃvāde prathamaḥ paṭalaḥyajjñātvā sādhayet siddhiṃ devānāmapi durlabhāmbrahmādīn mohayed devi bālakaṃ jananīṃ yathāmohayet kṣaṇmātreṇa prajāsu nṛpatiryathāanye ca mānavāḥ sarve meṣādijantavo yathāūrvaśyādyāstusvarveśyā rājapatnyādikāḥ kṣaṇātdrāvaṇaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ caiva vidveṣoccāṭane tathāvaśīkaraṇamanyāni sādhayet sādhakottamaḥkaṭākṣeṇaiva sarvāṇi sādhakasya na cānyathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00132 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasyā'sādhyaṃ tribhuvane na kiñcit prāṇavallabhevyaṅgavarṇayutaṃ devi nādabinduyutaṃ punaḥekaṃ vāpi dvayaṃ vāpi caturthaṃ vā japet sudhīḥanyathā siddhihāniḥ syād vighnasteṣāṃ pade pademahāmāyāvratāḥ sarve tailayantre vṛṣā ivanātra cakraviśuddhistu kālādiśodhanaṃ na cakleśaśūnyaṃ paraṃ devi sādhanaṃ drutapoṣakamkā gatistasya deveśaḥ nistāro vidyate na vākiṃ brūmo devadeveśi kālikātāriṇīmanumkṛte cakrādigaṇane śūnīviṣṭhākṛmirbhavetasyāḥ pūjāṃ pravakṣyāmi trailokyasādhanapradāmprāpyate tatkṣaṇenaiva nātra kāryā vicāraṇānijabījāni tanmadhye yojayet sādhakottamaḥaṣṭadikṣu yajet tāṃ tu nyāsajālaṃ vidhāya cakāmākhyā devatā sarvasiddhaye viniyojitāṣaḍdīrghabhājāṃ dhyāyet tu kāmākhyāmiṣṭadāyinīmniṣkalaṅkāṃ sudhādhāmavadanāmalakojjvalāmnānāratnādinirmāṇasiṃhāsanoparisthitāmpīnottuṅgakucāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ śrutimūlagatekṣaṇāmsarvāṅgāninditāṃ nānāvidyābhiḥ pariveṣṭitāmkāminībhiryutāṃ nānāgandhādyaiḥ parigandhitāmsamastasiddhavargāṇāṃ praṇatānāṃ pratīkṣaṇāmbhagaliṅgasamākhyānāṃ kinnarībhyo'pi śṛṇvatīmaśeṣaguṇasampannāṃ karuṇāsāgarāṃ śivāmpūjayitvā yathoktena vidhānena harapriye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00132 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: javā - yāvaka - sindūraiḥ karavīrairviśeṣataḥjavāyāṃ ca tathā viddhi mālatyādisamīpakepradānāt tu javāyāśca gāṇapatyamavāpnuyātpañcatattvaṃ vinā pūjāmabhicārāya kalpayetpañcamena mahādevi śivo bhavati sādhakaḥpañcatattvaṃ paraṃ brahma pañcatattvaṃ parā gatiḥpañcatattvaṃ bhuktimuktī mahāyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥnaśyanti tatkṣaṇenaiva tūlarāśimivānalaḥpañcatattvavihīne tu vimukhī jagadambikāmatsyena bhairavīputro mudrayā sādhutāṃ vrajetbhaktiyukto yajed devīṃ tadā sarvaṃ prajāyatekuṅkumādyairāsavena cārghyaṃ devyai nivedayetvastrabhūṣādibhirdevīṃ prapūjyāvaraṇaṃ yajetpārśvayoḥ kamalāṃ vāṇīṃ pūjayet sādhakottamaḥrasadā mohadā devi ṛddhidā siddhidāpi camokṣadā sukhadā caiva jñānadā kāntidā tathāḍākinyādyāstahā pūjyāḥ siddhayo yatnataḥ śiveyathāśakti japenmantraṃ śuddhabhāvena sādhakaḥpaṭhet stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ praṇamed vidhinā'munānirmālyaṃ nikṣipedaiśe trikoṇaṃ parikalpayetviharet pañcatattvena yathāvidhi svaśaktitaḥśaktimūlā japāścaiva śaktimūlaṃ ca jīvanamśaktimūlaṃ tapaḥ sarvaṃ caturvargastathā priyeajñātvā pāpino devi rauravaṃ yānti niścitamśaktyucchiṣṭaṃ pīyate hi nānyathā yānti rauravam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00132 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saphalaṃ karma tat sarvaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ kuleśvarisa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ nistāro na hi vidyatetaṃ taṃ kāmaṃ kare kṛtvā priye jayati niścitamtaddaśāṃśaṃ hunedājyaiḥ śarkarāmadhupāyasaiḥgandhādyaiḥ sādhakādhīśastatkuśairabhiṣecayetmiṣṭānnaiḥ sādhakān devi devībhaktāṃśca pañcamaiḥprayogeṣu tato devi yogyo bhavati niścitammahāprītikarī pūjā yonicakre kuleśvaritatra devīṃ yajed dhimān saiva devī na cā'nyathālepayet tāṃ tu gandhādyaiḥ pūjayed vividhena cayonipūjāsamā pūjā nāsti jñāne tu māmakedarśanāt sādhakādhīśaḥ sparśanāt sarvamohanaḥtadeva jīvanaṃ tasyā girije bahu kiṃ vacaḥparastrīyonimāsādya viśeṣeṇa yajet sudhīḥtrirātrādeva sidhyanti nātra kāryā vicāraṇāacirāt siddhimāpnoti devānāmapi durlabhāmvinā tat sādhanaṃ devi mahāśāpaḥ prajāyateacirād rauravaṃ yāti devi satyaṃ śivājñayātasmānna nindayed yoniṃ yadīcchedātmano hitamyonistutiparo devi śivaḥ syāt tatkṣaṇena cacāñcalyād gaditaṃ kiñcit kṣantavyaṃ kāmarūpiṇi|| iti śrīkāmākhyātantre devīśvarasaṃvāde dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥyasya prasādamātreṇa brahmaviṣṇuśivā apigandharvāḥ kinnarā devi tathā vidyādharādayaḥyoginī - ḍākinī - vidyā - bhairavī - nāyikādikāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00132 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svarge martye ca pātāle ye ye sidhyanti sādhakāḥvadhūbījatrayaṃ caiva kāmākhyā ca punarvadetṭhadvayānte manuḥ proktaḥ sarvatantreṣu durlabhaḥcaturvagapradā sākṣānmahāpātakanāśinīnaśyanti dahane dīpte pataṅgā iva pārvatibhuktirmuktiḥ kare tasya sarveṣāṃ priyatāṃ vrajetputrāḥ pautrāḥ prapautrāśca bhavanti cirajīvinaḥlipiścalati tasyaiva nātra kāryā vicāraṇānāma śrutvā vāramekaṃ palāyante ca hiṃsakāḥsādhakānāṃ paricaryāṃ kurvanti nātra saṃśayaḥsabhāyāṃ koṭisūryābhaṃ paśyanti sarvasajjanāḥvarṇituṃ naiva śaknomi mantrametanmaheśvaripuraścaryāvidhau kintu ṣaṭsahasraṃ manuṃ japetsiddho bhavati mantrajñaḥ prayogeṣu tataḥ kṣamaḥdāridryahananaṃ devi kṣaṇenaiva na cānyathāsuratarutalapīṭhe ratnasiṃhāsanasthāmkālikaluṣanihantrīṃ yonirūpāṃ bhajāmigopitaṃ sarvatantreṣu tava bhāvāt prakāśitamtūlikāyāṃ mahādevi kulaśaktiṃ samāviśettasyādharo yathā bhṛṅgo nīrajavyākulaḥ priyeāliṅgayenmadonmattaḥ sudṛḍhaṃ kucamardanampunaḥ punaścumbanaṃ ca yonau kuryāt kuleśvariāghātaistoṣayet tāṃ tu sandhānabhedataḥ priyeaṣṭottaraśataṃ mantraṃ japeddhomādikāṅkṣayāprāpyate mānasaṃ vastu nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00132 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karavīraprasūnaṃ ca tasyā liṅgopari nyasetdinatrayaṃ tato devyāḥ prītiḥ syādacalā priyeānandaṃ varddhayennityaṃ sādhakasya mahātmanaḥpunarliṅge sthite yonau japeccāṣṭasahasrakamnityaṃ tasya maheśāni nāyikāsaṅgamo bhavettasyā yonau yajed devīṃ hṛṣṭacittena sādhakaḥyoniṃ vīkṣya japenmantraṃ saptarātramatandritaḥājñāṃ gṛhṇāti dhanadastasya devi na saṃśayaḥtadā siddhimavāpnoti cānyathā hāsyameva hidurvahā gurutā yā tu sambhavenmānuṣe kathamdūrīkuru mahādeva saṃśayaṃ me mahotkaṭamśṛṇu sārataraṃ jñānaṃ sādhūnāṃ hitakāraṇammahākāyayuto devaḥ saccidānandavigrahaḥtvatprasādānmahādevi śivo'hamajarāmaraḥdīkṣāyai sādhakānāṃ ca vṛkṣādau pūjanaṃ yathātad dhyānaṃ śiṣyaśirasi copadiṣṭaṃ na cānyathāmānuṣe gurutā devi kalpanā na tu tathyatātat padaṃ darśitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥata eva nare devi gurutā kalpanaiva hiayaṃ gururiti jñānaṃ śiṣyo'yaṃ khalu me yadāmokṣo na jāyate satyaṃ mānuṣe gurubhāvanātdīyate tat tathā devi tasmai sarvaṃ samarpaṇamtadā tyajet tu tat pātramanyapātreṇa toṣayetasammatastu lokairyastatra ruṣṭaḥ sadāśivaḥyathā tathaiva tasmai tu śiṣyadānaṃ samarpaṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00132 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anyadvāreṇa dātavyaṃ tāṃstān santyajya sarvadājñānānmokṣamavāpnoti tasmājjñānaṃ parāt paramannākāṅkṣī nirannaṃ ca yathā santyajati priyeajñāninaṃ varjayitvā śaraṇaṃ jñānino vrajetjñānāt kāmamavāpnoti jñānānmokṣo hi nirmalaḥjñānāya bhajate devaṃ jñānaṃ hi tapasaḥ phalamjñānalubdhastathā śiṣyo gurorguvantaraṃ vrajetdurlabhaḥ sadgururdevi śiṣyasantāpahārakaḥcakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥjñāninyeva śiṣyabhaktāḥ kevalaṃ niścitaṃ śivepañcatattvārcako yastu sadguruḥ sa prakīrtitaḥcamatkārī daivaśaktyā sadguruḥ kathitaḥ priyetantra mantraṃ samaṃ vakti ya eva sadguruśca saḥnigrahānugrahe śaktaḥ sadgururgīyate budhaiḥgurupādāmbuje bhaktiryasyaiva sadguruḥ smṛtaḥtyaktvā kṣamaṃ guruṃ śiṣyo nātra kālavicāraṇāvyaṅgitaśca samakṣe yo lokairnityo gururmataḥdṛṣṭvā'numodanaṃ nāsti tasya tad vastu kāmataḥśiṣyāhitaiṣiṇaṃ lokaṃ varjayet taṃ narādhamamsa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ śiṣyo'pi patito dhruvamtattvā''cāraṃ vadennaiva narakānna nivartatepaśordīkṣā'dhamā proktā caturvargavighātinīkaulāt tu kaulikīṃ prāthya tanmanuṃ punarālabhetanyayā vimukhī devī kutastasyaiva sadgatiḥtayorapi na kartavyā śiṣyeṇa gurubhāvanā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00132 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: divye vīravare vāpi na doṣo'tra śivājñayāvada me parameśāna śrotuṃ me cittamutsukamdivyaḥ sarvamanohārī mitavādī sthirāsanaḥgurupādāmbuje bhīruḥ sarvatra bhayavarjitaḥsarvaguṇānvito divyaḥ so'haṃ kiṃ bahuvākyataḥvācālo balavān śuddhaḥ pañcatattve sadā ratiḥmahāśayaḥ sadā devi sādhūnāṃ pālane rataḥevaṃ bahuguṇairyukto vīro rudraḥ svayaṃ priyeadhamān pāpacittāṃśca pañcatattvavinindakānkecit kharopamā bhraṣṭāḥ kecicca śūkaropamāḥeṣāṃ devyārcanaṃ siddhirgaṇanaṃ vā kuto bhavetvarjitāḥ sarvathā bhadre paramārthabahiṣkṛtāḥkṣudro hi paśubhāvaśca gadito yat svayaṃ sadādevatā naiva jānāti tasmāt samarpitaṃ na hisūryo yathā samāhanti cāndhakāraṃ kṣaṇādapiya uktaḥ paśubhāvo hi kalau kastasya pālakaḥśivena gaditaṃ yat tu tat satyamiti bhāvayantasyācāraṃ vadāmyāśu śṛṇu saṃśayanāśakamṛtusnātāṃ vinā nārīṃ kāmabhāvena hi spṛśetsaṃtyajenmatsyamāṃsāni pāśavo nityameva cadevālaye sadā tiṣṭhedāhārārthaṃ gṛhaṃ vrajetaiśvaryaṃ prārthayennaiva yadyasti tat tu na tyajetkārpadrohān kṣipet sarvānahaṅkārādikāṃstataḥkadācid dīkṣayennaiva pāśavaḥ parameśvariajñānād yadi vā lobhānmantradānaṃ karoti ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00132 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ityādi bahudhā''cārāḥ kvacid brūmaḥ paśormataḥyadi caṃkramaṇe śaktaḥ khaṅgadhāre sadā naraḥjambūdvīpe kalua devi brāhmaṇo hi kadācanasatye krameccaturvargaiḥ kṣīrājyamadhupiṣṭakaiḥmadhubhiḥ sarvavarṇaiśca pūjitā dvāpare yugenānukalpaḥ kalau durge nānukalpaḥ kalau yugena sandeho na sandeho na sandehaḥ kalau yugesadguroḥ śaraṇaṃ nītvā kulācāraṃ bhajennaraḥasādhyaṃ sādhayed divyo'pyanāyāsena yad bhuvipaśuḥ kalpaśatairvāpi sādhituṃ na ca tatkṣamaḥgopanīyaṃ gopanīyaṃ gopanīyaṃ sadā'naghe|| iti śrīkāmākhyātantre devīśvarasaṃvāde caturthaḥ paṭalaḥna kṛtvā pañcatattvaiśca pūjanaṃ parameśvarapañcatattvavihīnānāṃ nindanaṃ parameśvarimadhyaṃ vinā sādhanaṃ ca mahāhāsyāya kalpatetathānayoḥ sādhakānāṃ jñeyaṃ tattvaṃ vinā sadāanāvṛṣṭyā kṣitau devi karṣaṇaṃ ca yathā na higamanaṃ ca vinā kvāpi grāmaprāptiryathā na capañcatattvaiḥ sādhakendrāvarcayed vidhinā mudāstrībhiḥ sārddhaṃ sadā sādhurarcayejjagadambikāmkāyena manasā vācā tasmāt tattvaparo bhavetabrāhmaṇaḥ sa evoktaḥ sa eva hastimūrkhakaḥato na tarpayet so'pi yadīcchedātmano hitamśūdratvaṃ taccharīre tu prāptaṃ tena na cānyathāśūdro hi śūkaratvaṃ ca yāti yāti na saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00132 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcatattvairbhajed devīṃ na kuryāt saṃśayaṃ kvacittasyāsādhyaṃ tribhuvane na kiñcidapi vidyatesauraḥ sa paramārthī ca sa eva pūrṇadīkṣitaḥyājñikaḥ sarvakarmārhaḥ sa hi devo na cānyathātīrthānāṃ pāvanaḥ kaulo girije bahu kiṃ vacaḥdhanyā jātikuṭumbāśca dhanyā ālāpino janāḥapi kaścit kule'smākaṃ kulajñānī bhaviṣyatisamāgantumiti jñātvā sūtsukāḥ pitaraḥ parepañcavaktreṇa deveśi sanātanyāḥ phalāni cadivyaṃ ramyaṃ manohāri sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradamyat kañcid gaditaṃ pūrvaṃ vistṛtaṃ tad vadāmyahamstadupari khalu tiṣṭhet sādhanārthī kulajñaḥyadi japati vidhijñastatkṣaṇāt so'pyahaṃ casaṃprati japati subhaktyā tvatsutojāyate saḥjapati yadi vilāsī viṣṇureva svayaṃ saḥvrajati tamanu nityaṃ sārvabhaumo nṛṇāṃ saḥvigatajanasamūhe prāpya devi prakoṇepratijapati niśāyāṃ gahvare brahma kaḥ syātvrajati bhuvanamadhye dikpatitvaṃ ca ko'pibhavati bhuvanamadhye putradārairyuto'pisadasi vasati rājñaḥ sādaraḥ so'pi vandyaḥpañcamaḥ paṭalaḥmahāśatruvināśāya sādhanaṃ kiṃ vada prabhomahādhīraḥ sādhakendraḥ prayogaṃ tu samācaretmahānandamayo bhūtvā sādhayet sādhanaṃ mahat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00132 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tarpayed bhairavīṃ ghorāṃ sakalaṃ vā pibet svayamnagno bhūtvā ramet tatra śatrunāśo bhaved dhruvambhairavī kupitā tasya satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyahamsahasā narakaṃ yāti yāvaccandradivākarauvīro yastu mahādevi svecchācārī sadā śuciḥvāyunā pūritaṃ kṛtvā svamūtraṃ tatra nikṣipetbhairavyai darśayed devi māraṇoccāṭanaṃ bhavetśodhitvā bhairavīgātre niḥkṣipet sādhakottamaḥmohitaḥ kṣobhito vāpi vaśyo vāpi bhaved dhruvamnāśayet sādhako vīro nātra kāryā vicāraṇāśukro'haṃ śoṇitastvaṃ hi dvayorevākhilaṃ jagatevaṃ bhūtaśarīre tu yad yad vastu prajāyatebrahmajñānamidaṃ devi mayā te gaditaṃ kilabrahmajñānaṃ vinā devi na ca mokṣaḥ prajāyatekroḍe tasya vasantīha sarvatīrthāni niścitamṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥpūrṇābhiṣekaṃ kaulānāṃ vada me sukhamokṣadampūrṇābhiṣekaṃ sarvāśāpūrakaṃ śivatāpradamkaulaḥ sarvajanakhyātaścābhiṣekavidhiṃ caretveśyāṅganāḥ samānīya tattvāni ca sayatnataḥarcayedabhiṣekārthaṃ guruṃ vastrādibhūṣaṇaiḥprārthayecchuddhabhāvena kuladharmaṃ vadeti caabhiṣiñca sādhakañca sevārthaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatamsthāpayitvā puraḥ kumbhaṃ mantramudrādibhiḥ priyenānāpuṣpaistathā gandhaiḥ sarvopakaraṇairyajet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00132 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ādau strībhyaḥ samarpyaiva prasādālpaṃ bhajet tataḥabhiṣektā sādhakāṃśca pāyayet tu svayaṃ pibetrameran paramānandairveśyāyāṃ ca yathāsukhamabhiṣecanakarmāśu nirvighnaṃ ceti niścitamprātaḥkṛtyādikarmāṇi kuryāt tatraiva sādhakaḥśiṣyaścādau divārātramabhiṣikto bhavet tataḥna prakāṇḍaṃ na hi kṣudraṃ pramāṇaṃ ghaṭamāharetpravālaṃ hīrakaṃ muktāṃ svarṇaraupye tathaiva cakastūrīkuṅkumādīni nānāgandhāni cāharetvihitān dhūpadīpāṃśca ghṛtena parameśvariveśyābhiḥ sādhakaiḥ sārdhaṃ pūjanaṃ ca samācaretpūjāṃ samāpya devyāstu stavaistu praṇamenmudāāsanaṃ vastrabhūṣāṃ ca pratyekena kuleśvarighaṭasthāpanakaṃ kuryāt kramaṃ tatra śṛṇu priyeśaktyākalaśamāropya māyayā pūrayejjalaiḥāvāhayecca tīrthāni mantreṇānena deśikaḥsarve samudrāḥ saritaḥ sarāṃsi jaladā nadāḥsarvatīrthāni puṇyāni ghaṭe kurvantu sannidhimkūrcena phaladānaṃ syād gandhavastrahṛdātmanāmūlena dūrvāṃ praṇavaiḥ kuryādabhyukṣaṇaṃ tataḥvicintya mūlapīṭhaṃ tu tatra saṃyojya pūjayettadghaṭe hastamāropya śiṣyaṃ paśyan guruśca saḥsarvatīrthāmbusaṃpūrṇa pūrayāsya manorathammaṅgalairnikhilairdravyaiḥ sādhakaiḥ śaktibhiḥ sahaānandaiḥ parameśāni bhaktānāṃ hitakāriṇī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00132 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śmaśānabhairavī devī tripurānandabhairavītripureśī mahādevī tathā triṣuramālikāetāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantrapūtena vāriṇātārā ca jayadurgā ca śūlinī bhuvaneśvarīnityā ca nityarūpā ca vajraprastāriṇī tathāaśvārūḍhā maheśāni tathā mahiṣamardinītathā bhagandarī devī bhagaklinnā tathā parāsarvasiddhikarī devī siddhagandharvasevitāetāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantrapūtena vāriṇāmātaṅginī cānnapūrṇā rājarājeśvarī tathāugracaṇḍā pracaṇḍā ca caṇḍogrā caṇḍanāyikāetāstvāmamiṣiñcantu mantrapūtena vāriṇābhīmanetrā viśālākṣī maṅgalā vijayā jayāmaṅgalā nandinī bhadrā lakṣmīḥ kīrtiryaśasvinīśrīnandā ca sunandā ca nandinī nandapūjitāvijayā maṅgalā bhadrā dhṛtiḥ śāntiḥ śivā kṣamādīptā kāntiryaśolakṣmīrīśvarī buddhireva caajitā mānavī śvetā ditiścā'ditireva cakamalā vimalā gaurī śaraṇyambudhisundarīraudrī kālī ca māyūrī trinetrā cā'parājitācarcikā cāparā jñeyā tathaiva surapūjitāvaiṣṇavī ca mahālakṣmīḥ kārtikī kauṣikī tathāetāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantrapūtena vāriṇāpavano dhanadeśānau brahmā'nanto digīśvarāḥsaṃvatsaraścāyanau ca māsāḥ pakṣau dināni ca

sanskrit: rāhuḥ ketuśca satatamabhiṣiñcantu te grahāḥdagdhaṃ pāpaṃ tathā bhadrā yogā vārāḥ kṣaṇāstathāabhiṣiñcantu satataṃ mantrapūtena vāriṇākapālī bhīṣaṇākhyaśca saṃhāro'ṣṭau ca bhairavāḥḍākinīputrakāścaiva rākiṇīputrakāstathāśākinīputrakā bhūyo hākinīputrakāstathāmātṝṇāṃ ca tathā putrā ūrdhvamukhyāḥ sutāśca vaiabhiṣiñcantu te sarve mantrapūtena vāriṇāete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantrapūtena vāriṇāātmā'ntarātmā paramajñānātmānaḥ prakīrtitāḥete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantrapūtena vāriṇāśaktibījaṃ ramābījaṃ māyābījaṃ sudhākarammārtaṇḍabhairavaṃ daurgaṃ bījaṃ śrīpuruṣottamametāni cābhiṣiñcantu mantrapūtena vāriṇāātreyī bhāratī caiva sarayūrgaṇḍakī tathābhogavatī ca pātāle svarge mandākinī tathābhairavo bhīmarūpaśca śoṇo gharghara eva caete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantrapūtena vāriṇātāni tvāmabhiṣiñcantu mantrapūtena vāriṇāvauṣaṭkāraṃ tu phaṭkāramabhiṣiñcantu sarvadāanantādyāstathā nāgāḥ sarpā ye takṣakādayaḥnaśyantu pretakūṣmāṇḍā rākṣasā dānavāśca yealakṣmīḥ kālakarṇī ca pāpāni ca mahānti carogāḥ śokāśca dāridryaṃdaurbalyaṃ cittavikriyātejohrāso balahrāso buddhihrāsastathaiva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00132 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viṣā'pamṛtyurogāśca ḍākinyādibhayaṃ tathānaśyantu cābhiṣekeṇa kālībījena tāṭitāḥabhiṣekeṇa śāktena pūrṇāḥ santu manorathāḥtadā siddhirbhavet satyaṃ nānyathā vacanaṃ mamadakṣiṇāṃ gurave dadyāt svarṇakāñcanamānataḥtoṣayet stutivākyaiśca praṇamet punareva hivātsalyairvividhaiḥ śiṣyaṃ grāhayet tattvamuttamambhairavāḥ śaktayaścāpi kuryurāśīḥ suyatnataḥaṣṭame divase śiṣyaṃ punaḥ kuryāt tu secanamkundukāṃśca tathā saptasampattihetave priyedadyāt prayatnataḥ sādhurviddhi devi samāpanamguruḥ kaulādhikārī syādatra tanme vada prabhonigrahānugrahe śaktaḥ śiṣyapālanatatparaḥśraddhāvānāgame nityaṃ so'dhikartā na cānyathāsāmānyakaulaṃ varade varjayenmatimān sadāudāsīnamukhād dīkṣā vandhyā nārī yathā priyeabhiṣikto bhaved devi vighnastasya pade padesarvaṃ hi viphalaṃ tasya narakaṃ yāti cāntimetato hi bahujanmabhyo devīmantramavāpnuyātabhiṣecanakarmāṇi punaḥ kuryāt prayatnataḥvidyāpi jananī tulyā pātitaṃ satataṃ priyeudāsīnaṃ parityajya tathā'bhiṣecanaṃ śatamsa eva brāhmaṇo dhanyo devīdevaparāyaṇaḥtasyaiva saphalaṃ karma tasyaiva saphalaṃ dhanamdīkṣā hi saphalā devi kriyā ca saphalā tanuḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00132 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yatra deśe vaset sādhuḥ so'pi vārāṇasīsamaḥsatyaṃ satyaṃ mahāmāye punaḥ satyaṃ mayoditamsarvatantreṣu tānyasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīmjāyate devadeveśi satyaṃ satyaṃ mayoditamgaṇeśaḥ pātramatraiva kārttikeyo'pi pārvatipañcavaktraiśca śakto na varṇituṃ parameśvarigopanīyaṃ gopanīyaṃ gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥtathaiva tu mahāmāye gopanīyaṃ mamājñayā|| iti śrīkāmākhyātantre pārvatīśvarasaṃvāde saptamaḥ paṭalaḥyasmin ṣaḍdarśanānīha copahāsyagatāni caetanmarma ca deveśi ahaṃ vedmi tathā hariḥlaguḍena yathā devi badhnāti durjanaṃ nṛpaḥdurjane yadi muktiḥ syācchaṅkīyati śubhānaneparamārthaṃ na jānanti darvīpākarasaṃ yathādarśaneṣu tathā muktirnāsti devi mayoditamdarśanebhyo nivartante tathā mumukṣavaḥ punaḥvicaret sarvaśāstreṣu kautukāya tataḥ sudhīḥśarīradhāraṇaṃ yasya kurvantīha punaḥ punaḥtadānanāt tato dīrghā bhaktistasyāḥ prajāyatejñānānmokṣo bhavet satyamiti śāstrasya nirṇayaḥsārūpyaṃ sahayojyaṃ ca nirvāṇaṃ hi parāt paramsāyujyaṃ kalayā yuktaṃ nirvāṇaṃ tu manolayaḥtat kiṃ vada mahādeva saṃśayaṃ layasāt kurudurjanatvāllopayitvā krīḍayāmi surānahamprāptā mayā viṣṇunā ca brahmaṇā nāradādibhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00132 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tridhā sāyojyavāneti nirvāṇī sarvameva himuktasyaiva sadā sphītā sphuratyavirataṃ priyeparā ca jananī saiva sarvābhīṣṭapradāyinīmuktijñānaṃ kulajñānaṃ nānyajñānaṃ kuleśvarisvarge martye ca pātāle ye ye muktā bhavanti hitathā ca sādhanaṃ jñeyaṃ pañcatattvaiśca muktidamdīkṣā kulātmikā devi śrīgurormukhapaṅkajātjñātvā caivaṃ prayatnena kulajñānaṃ bhajed budhaḥmukteśca kāraṇaṃ tasyāḥ svayaṃ jñātaṃ na cānyathāātmayoniryathā devi tathā gopyaṃ mamājñayāsā kā vada jagannātha kapaṭaṃ mā kuru prabhośrutvaitad girijāvākyaṃ prahasyovāca śaṅkaraḥyā devī kālikā mātā sarvavidyāsvarūpiṇīsaiva brahmeti jānīhi saṃjñārthaṃ darśanāni caasyā hi jāyate sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaramsthūlā sūkṣmā parā devī saccidānandarūpiṇīmuktimayī jagaddhātrī sadānandamayī tathāyathā karmasamāptau ca dakṣiṇā phalasiddhidāato hi dakṣiṇākālī kathyate varavarṇiniuktāni sarvatantrāṇi tantreṇānena niścitampaṭhitvā śrāvayed vāpi śṛṇoti pūjayed yadiyathāsparśamaṇirdevi tathaitat tantramuttamamyathā sarvāṇi ratnāni sāgare santi niścitamsarvadevāśayo meruryathā siddhaṃ tathā punaḥyasya gehe sthitaṃ devi tantrametad bhayāpaham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00132 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatra dasyubhayaṃ nāsti graharājabhayaṃ na cana parājayameṣāṃ hi bhayaṃ devi mayoditamna bhayaṃ kvāpi sarveṣāṃ vyāghrādīnāṃ tathaiva cavināyakānāṃ sarveṣāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ tathā na cahiṃsrā vighnakarāścaiva na teṣāṃ bhayamīśvarisatyaṃ satyaṃ mahādevi śapathena vadāmyahamvāṇī tathaiva devvyāstu prasādācala īritaḥgopanīyaṃ gopanīyaṃ gopanīyaṃ sadā priyebhraṣṭānāṃ sādhakānāṃ ca sānnidhye na vadedapiudāsīnajanasyaiva sānnidhye na vadedapimūrkhāya bhāvahīnāya daridrāya mamājñayākālībhaktāya śaivāya vaiṣṇavāya śivājñayāsurā - strī - vandakāyā'pi śivābalipradāya ca||iti śrīkāmākhyātantre pārvatīśvarasaṃvāde navamaḥ paṭalaḥ samāptaḥ
